hlaunit.hla13.ddm

Class RegionTest

  • java.lang.Object
    • hlaunit.hla13.common.Abstract13Test
      • hlaunit.hla13.ddm.RegionTest

  • public class RegionTest
extends Abstract13Test
    The tests in this class validate the behaviour of a Region. They ensure that once a region has been created, that it behaves as expected. The methods DO NOT explicitly test the process of create/destroying a region etc...

      • testRegionSetRangeWithSillyYetValidValues

        public void testRegionSetRangeWithSillyYetValidValues()
                                               throws Exception
        Although it doesn't make much sense, it is valid to set* the values of a range to illogical settings (e.g. where lowerBound > upperBound). This test will ensure that this is possible.

        *Note that this is actually invalid. Although it is allowed now, it should cause an exception later on when attempting to use this invalid region

        Throws:
        Exception
